name: ServiceTitan
description: ServiceTitan field service management for HVAC, plumbing, electrical and other trades: customers and locations, leads, jobs and appointments, dispatch, capacity and technician shifts, technicians and business units, invoices and payments, estimates, pricebook services and materials, memberships and phone calls. Can create customers, book jobs, add appointments, reschedule, assign technicians, add notes and cancel jobs.
instructions:
## ServiceTitan
This connector works with the **ServiceTitan API v2** (`https://api.servicetitan.io`) of one ServiceTitan account (tenant), for home and commercial service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control): customers and locations (CRM), jobs and appointments (job planning), dispatch and capacity, technicians and settings, invoices and payments, estimates, the pricebook, memberships and phone calls.

**Setup (about 15 minutes, needs a ServiceTitan admin)**
1. Sign in to the ServiceTitan Developer Portal (https://developer.servicetitan.io) with an account that may create apps for your company and create a **custom app** for your own tenant. Under the app's API scopes tick the **read** scopes of the modules you want (CRM customers, locations, contacts and leads; JPM jobs, appointments, job notes, job history, job types, job cancel reasons, projects; Dispatch appointment assignments, teams, zones, technician shifts; Settings technicians, employees, business units, tag types; Accounting invoices, payments, payment types; Sales estimates; Pricebook services, materials, equipment, categories; Memberships; Telecom calls; Marketing campaigns) and the **write** scopes only for what the AI may change (CRM customers and locations, JPM jobs and appointments, Dispatch appointment assignments and `tn.dis.capacity:w` for capacity checks, Sales estimates). Copy the app's **App Key** into `SERVICETITAN_APP_KEY`.
2. In ServiceTitan go to **Settings, Integrations, API Application Access**, connect the app (**Connect New App**, allow access) and click **Generate** to create the **Client ID** and **Client Secret**. Paste them into `SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_ID` and `SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_SECRET`. The same page shows the **Tenant ID** (a number): paste it into `SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID`.
3. Install. AnythingMCP gets an access token from `https://auth.servicetitan.io/connect/token` (OAuth client credentials, renewed automatically about every 15 minutes) and sends the App Key as the `ST-App-Key` header on every call. The check runs `servicetitan_list_customers`.

Credentials of ServiceTitan's **integration** (sandbox) environment do not work here: this connector talks to production.

**Workflow**
- Find a customer: `servicetitan_list_customers` (name, phone, address), then `servicetitan_get_customer`, `servicetitan_list_customer_contacts`, `servicetitan_list_customer_notes`. Locations: `servicetitan_list_locations` (customer_id), `servicetitan_get_location`, `servicetitan_list_location_contacts`. Leads that did not book yet: `servicetitan_list_leads`.
- New customer: `servicetitan_create_customer` (with at least one location), more sites with `servicetitan_create_location`; change with `servicetitan_update_customer`; notes with `servicetitan_add_customer_note`.
- Book work: look up `servicetitan_list_business_units`, `servicetitan_list_job_types` and `servicetitan_list_campaigns`, check free slots with `servicetitan_get_capacity`, then `servicetitan_create_job` with the first appointment. More visits: `servicetitan_add_appointment`; move one: `servicetitan_reschedule_appointment`.
- Jobs: `servicetitan_list_jobs` (status, customer, technician, dates), `servicetitan_get_job`, `servicetitan_get_job_history`, `servicetitan_list_job_notes`, `servicetitan_add_job_note`, `servicetitan_update_job`. Cancel with a reason from `servicetitan_list_job_cancel_reasons` via `servicetitan_cancel_job` (confirm with the user first). Larger work: `servicetitan_list_projects`.
- Schedule and dispatch: `servicetitan_list_appointments`, `servicetitan_get_appointment`, `servicetitan_list_appointment_assignments`, `servicetitan_assign_technicians`, `servicetitan_unassign_technicians`, `servicetitan_list_technician_shifts`, `servicetitan_list_teams`, `servicetitan_list_zones`.
- People and setup: `servicetitan_list_technicians`, `servicetitan_get_technician`, `servicetitan_list_employees`, `servicetitan_list_tag_types`.
- Money: `servicetitan_list_invoices` (by customer, job or ids), `servicetitan_list_payments`, `servicetitan_list_payment_types`.
- Sales: `servicetitan_list_estimates`, `servicetitan_get_estimate`, `servicetitan_list_estimate_items`; `servicetitan_sell_estimate` marks one sold.
- Pricebook: `servicetitan_list_pricebook_services`, `servicetitan_list_pricebook_materials`, `servicetitan_list_pricebook_equipment` (search_text), `servicetitan_list_pricebook_categories`.
- Memberships: `servicetitan_list_memberships`, `servicetitan_get_membership`, `servicetitan_list_membership_types`, `servicetitan_list_recurring_service_events` (maintenance visits due).
- Calls: `servicetitan_list_calls`, `servicetitan_get_call`.

**Reading the answers**: ids are integers. Times are UTC in ISO 8601 (`2026-10-30T14:00:00Z`); convert to the business's time zone before quoting them, and send UTC when booking. Accounting amounts (`total`, `balance`, `subTotal`) come as decimal strings in the account currency. A customer is the bill-to account; work happens at its locations, and every job belongs to one location.

**Paging**: lists answer `{ page, pageSize, hasMore, totalCount, data }`. Ask for the next `page` while `hasMore` is true; `include_total` adds `totalCount`. `ids` filters take at most 50 comma-separated ids. Most lists return only active records unless `active` is `Any` or `False`. `modified_on_or_after` picks up changes since a date.

**Writes**: updates change only the fields passed; list fields such as `tag_type_ids` replace the whole list. Show the user what will be booked, cancelled or changed and wait for a yes. Nothing here deletes records.

**Limits and errors**: ServiceTitan limits requests per app and tenant and answers 429 when they come too fast; wait and retry. 401 means the client ID or secret is wrong or the app was disconnected; 403 means the app lacks the scope for that module (add it in the Developer Portal, then reconnect in API Application Access) or the App Key is missing or wrong; 404 an unknown id or a wrong tenant ID; 400 lists the invalid fields.
prerequisites: A ServiceTitan account (tenant) and an admin who can create a custom app in the ServiceTitan Developer Portal (App Key) and connect it under Settings, Integrations, API Application Access (Client ID, Client Secret, Tenant ID).

SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_ID.help: ServiceTitan, Settings, Integrations, API Application Access: the Client ID generated for your app (starts with cid.).
SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste only the client ID, without spaces.

SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret
SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Shown once when you click Generate in API Application Access (starts with cs). Generate a new one if it is lost.
SERVICETITAN_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste only the client secret, without spaces.

SERVICETITAN_APP_KEY.label: App Key
SERVICETITAN_APP_KEY.help: ServiceTitan Developer Portal, your app: the Application Key (starts with ak1.). Sent as the ST-App-Key header.
SERVICETITAN_APP_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the App Key, without spaces.

SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID.label: Tenant ID
SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID.help: The number of your ServiceTitan account, shown in Settings, Integrations, API Application Access.
SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID.patternMessage: The tenant ID is a number.

verifyHints.401: ServiceTitan refused the client ID or secret. Generate them again in Settings, Integrations, API Application Access and check that the app is still connected.
verifyHints.403: The app has no scope for this module, or the App Key is wrong. Add the scope to the app in the Developer Portal and reconnect it in API Application Access.
verifyHints.404: Unknown tenant or record. Check SERVICETITAN_TENANT_ID.
verifyHints.429: ServiceTitan is rate limiting this app. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: servicetitan_list_customers
tools.description: List or search customers (bill-to accounts): id, name, type (Residential or Commercial), active, balance, bill-to address, doNotMail/doNotService flags, tag ids, created and modified times. Filter by name, phone, address parts, ids or change date. Answers { page, pageSize, hasMore, data }.

phone.description: Phone number of one of the customer's contacts.

active.description: True (default): active only, False: inactive only, Any: both.

created_on_or_after.description: Only records created at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

modified_on_or_after.description: Only records changed at or after this UTC time, ISO 8601. Use it to pick up changes since a last sync.

page_size.description: Records per page (50 by default). Keep it at a few hundred or less.

include_total.description: Also return totalCount (slower on big lists).

page_size.description: Records per page (50 by default). Keep it at a few hundred or less.

include_total.description: Also return totalCount (slower on big lists).

tools.name: servicetitan_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer together with at least one service location. The bill-to address and every location need street, city, state, zip and country. Returns the new customer with its id; read the location ids with servicetitan_list_locations (customer_id).

address.description: Address: street, unit (optional), city, state, zip, country (all text; country e.g. USA, Canada).

locations.description: Service locations: each { name, address { street, unit, city, state, zip, country }, contacts (optional) }. At least one.

address.description: Address: street, unit (optional), city, state, zip, country (all text; country e.g. USA, Canada).

contacts.description: Contact methods: each { type: Phone, MobilePhone, Email or Fax, value, memo (optional, e.g. office) }.
Contact methods: each { type: Phone, MobilePhone, Email or Fax, value, memo (optional, e.g. office) }.

do_not_mail.description: Flag the customer as do not mail.

do_not_service.description: Flag the customer as do not service.

add_to_locations.description: Also add it to the customer's active locations.
